sources.finding: PROMETHEVS 0.2 is released; requires Windows, 64GB RAM, 12GB NVIDIA, ~1.1TB free NVMe, 475GiB download and ~4h store build; actual comparison remains one machine/one model/three prompts vs original weights. Current host Linux and model volumes only 59GB and 26GB free.

Gyro-Coder-L targets 32GB card, 27.54GiB GPU weights and 78.2GiB file; official card says Strata support coming and stock llama.cpp cannot load. Current storage is insufficient once N-gram/table is included.
Basalt explicitly requires Blackwell compute capability 12.0/CUDA 13; NVIDIA lists RTX 3090 as 8.6. Its NVFP4 benchmark is not portable to this Ampere host.

Published system is RTX5060Ti 16GB/64GB/Strata 0.1.47, 3-run medians; model 87.25GB and PLE 26.82GB. Current volumes 59GB and 26GB free cannot hold the artifacts; local Q26 Unsloth QFN is a different weight revision.

Strata lists Qwen3.6-35B-A3B support, but the qwen35 path runs on GPU0 only; current issue asks for multi-GPU layer split and is still open. A one-GPU test would not answer the requested dual-3090 comparison.
